metadata.title: Expense Tracker
metadata.description: Track expenses, monitor spending habits, and gain insights through clear dashboards and visual analytics.

hero.subtitle: Track expenses, monitor spending habits, and gain insights through clear dashboards and visual analytics.
hero.feature1Desc: Record transactions with a date, amount, description, and category.
hero.feature2Desc: Explore income, expenses, and category breakdowns in your dashboard.
hero.feature3Desc: Set a budget for each category and compare it with your spending.

quickStart.heading: Get started in three steps
quickStart.subtitle: From your first transaction to a view of your spending
quickStart.step1Desc: Sign up and sign in to your personal workspace.
quickStart.step2Desc: Enter income and expenses, or preview and import a Nordea CSV file.
quickStart.step3Desc: Review spending by category and compare it with your monthly budgets.

features.heading: Tools for everyday expense tracking
features.subtitle: Record, organize, and understand your finances
features.visualReportsDesc: View income, expenses, net totals, and spending by category for your selected period.
features.categoriesDesc: Create and rename categories, then choose a category for your transactions.
features.csvImportDesc: Preview transactions from a supported Nordea CSV file before importing them.
features.monthlyBudgetsDesc: Set spending amounts for each category and compare budgets with actual expenses.
features.filtersDesc: Filter transactions by date range and category, and sort the table.
features.mobileFriendlyDesc: Manage your finances from a desktop or mobile browser.

trust.heading: Built for your personal finances
trust.secureDesc: Authentication protects access to your personal workspace.
trust.privacyDesc: Your transactions, categories, and budgets are stored in PostgreSQL and linked to your signed-in account.

cta.heading: Start understanding your spending
cta.subtitle: Add your transactions, organize your categories, and see where your money goes.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Record income and expenses, organize them into your own categories, and set monthly category budgets. The dashboard shows totals, charts, and budget comparisons.
faq.q2: Can I connect my bank account?
faq.a2: There is no automatic bank connection. You can add transactions manually or import a supported Nordea CSV file after reviewing the preview.
faq.a3: You choose categories yourself. Create categories to suit your spending and assign them when adding or editing transactions.
faq.q4: Can I use it on my phone and change languages?
faq.a4: Yes. The responsive web app works in a mobile browser, and you can switch between English and Finnish using the language menu.

overview.heading: A clearer view of everyday finances
overview.subtitle: A responsive finance app with secure sign-in and a PostgreSQL database, built around expense tracking and visual insights.
overview.item1Desc: Add, edit, and delete income and expenses as your records change.
overview.item2Desc: Use the web app in your browser, in English or Finnish.
overview.item3Desc: Sign in to manage the transactions, categories, and budgets linked to your account.
